attempts.plan:
1. Load the two CSV files into pandas DataFrames:  
   a. trips (each row = one ride)  
   b. borough_adjacency (two-column edge list)  

2. Confirm data health.  
   • Row count in profiler = 127 915, “no missing values detected”.  
   • Re-check with trips.isna().any(). If any future NA rows are found, drop them for the relevant columns before aggregation; otherwise proceed unchanged.

3. Compute borough-level metrics from trips:  
   a. Departures_i  = trips.groupby('start_borough').size()  
   b. SelfTrips_i   = trips[ trips.start_borough == trips.end_borough ]  
                      .groupby('start_borough').size()  
   c. SCR_i (= Self-Containment Ratio) = SelfTrips_i / Departures_i  
   Save results in a pandas Series indexed by borough name.

4. Build an adjacency weight matrix W (binary):  
   • For each row (b1, b2) in borough_adjacency add b2 to neighbor list of b1 and vice-versa.  
   • Store as dict {borough: [neigh1, …]} and convert to equal-row-length numpy array when needed.  
   • No self-weights.

5. Calculate Local Moran’s I for each borough using only numpy/pandas:  
   a. Standardize SCR: z = (SCR – mean)/std.  
   b. For borough i: I_i = z_i * Σ_j w_ij z_j, with w_ij from W.  
   c. Permutation test for significance:  
      – Repeat 999 random shuffles of z across borough labels.  
      – For each permutation recompute I_i^(perm).  
      – p-value_i = proportion of |I_i^(perm)| ≥ |I_i| (two-tailed).  
   d. Record each borough’s I_i, z_i, neighbor mean z̄_Ni, and p-value_i.

6. Classify spots:  
   • HOT SPOT (HH) if:  
     – z_i > 0 (high SCR) AND neighbor mean z̄_Ni > 0  
     – p-value_i < 0.05 (significant Local Moran’s I)  
   • COLD SPOT (LL) if:  
     – z_i < 0 (low SCR) AND neighbor mean z̄_Ni < 0  
     – p-value_i < 0.05  
   • Ignore HL/LH (outliers) and all non-significant cases.

7. Prepare explanation:  
   • Report each selected borough’s SCR (actual value), Local Moran’s I, neighbor mean SCR, and p-value.  
   • Briefly interpret why each meets HH or LL criteria.

8. Output exactly one summary line, comma-separated:  
   FINAL ANSWER: BoroughA (HH, p=<value>), BoroughB (LL, p=<value>), …

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. LOAD DATA
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
TRIPS_PATH = "chunks_csv/cyclehire_w004.csv"
ADJ_PATH   = "chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv"

trips = pd.read_csv(TRIPS_PATH)
adj   = pd.read_csv(ADJ_PATH)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. BASIC CLEAN-UP  (drop rows without a borough on either end)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
trips = trips.dropna(subset=['StartBorough', 'EndBorough'])
data_points_used = len(trips)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. SELF-CONTAINMENT RATIO (SCR)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
departures      = trips.groupby('StartBorough').size().rename('departures')
self_contained  = (
    trips.loc[trips['StartBorough'] == trips['EndBorough']]
         .groupby('StartBorough')
         .size()
         .rename('self_contained')
)
scr = (self_contained / departures).fillna(0)  # any borough with 0 self trips gets 0

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. BUILD ADJACENCY LIST  (undirected, no self-links)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
neighbors = {b: set() for b in scr.index}
for b, n in adj.itertuples(index=False):
    if b in neighbors: neighbors[b].add(n)
    if n in neighbors: neighbors[n].add(b)

# keep only boroughs that have at least one neighbour in our SCR set
neighbors = {b:{n for n in neigh if n in scr.index} for b,neigh in neighbors.items()}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. LOCAL MORAN’S I  (row-standardised weights)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
z = (scr - scr.mean()) / scr.std(ddof=0)
z = z.fillna(0)

local_I   = {}
p_values  = {}

rng = np.random.default_rng(2024)
perms = 999
z_values = z.values
boroughs = z.index.to_list()
idx_map  = {b:i for i,b in enumerate(boroughs)}  # quick lookup

# pre-compute neighbour index list & row-standardised weights
neigh_idx  = {b: np.array([idx_map[n] for n in ns]) for b,ns in neighbors.items()}
weights    = {b: np.full(len(ns), 1/len(ns))        for b,ns in neighbors.items()}

# real statistics
for b in boroughs:
    if len(neigh_idx[b]) == 0:
        local_I[b]  = np.nan
        p_values[b] = np.nan
        continue
    zi   = z_values[idx_map[b]]
    wz   = (weights[b] * z_values[neigh_idx[b]]).sum()
    local_I[b] = zi * wz

# permutation distribution
perm_I = np.empty((len(boroughs), perms))
for p in range(perms):
    z_perm = rng.permutation(z_values)
    for i,b in enumerate(boroughs):
        if len(neigh_idx[b]) == 0:
            perm_I[i,p] = np.nan
            continue
        zi   = z_perm[i]
        wz   = (weights[b] * z_perm[neigh_idx[b]]).sum()
        perm_I[i,p] = zi * wz

# p-values (two-sided)
for i,b in enumerate(boroughs):
    if np.isnan(local_I[b]):
        p_values[b] = np.nan
        continue
    larger = np.sum(np.abs(perm_I[i, :]) >= np.abs(local_I[b]))
    p_values[b] = (larger + 1) / (perms + 1)   # +1 for observed - avoids zero

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. CLASSIFY HOT/COLD SPOTS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
hot_cold = {}
for b in boroughs:
    if np.isnan(local_I[b]) or np.isnan(p_values[b]): 
        continue
    nz = z[b]
    neigh_z_mean = (weights[b] * z_values[neigh_idx[b]]).sum() if len(neigh_idx[b]) else np.nan
    if   (nz > 0) and (neigh_z_mean > 0) and (p_values[b] < 0.05):
        hot_cold[b] = ("HH", local_I[b], p_values[b])
    elif (nz < 0) and (neigh_z_mean < 0) and (p_values[b] < 0.05):
        hot_cold[b] = ("LL", local_I[b], p_values[b])

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. EXPLANATION
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"data_points_used = {data_points_used}")

for b,(typ,Iv,pv) in hot_cold.items():
    print(f"{b}: SCR={scr[b]:.4f}, Local I={Iv:.4f}, p={pv:.4f}, classification={typ}")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. FINAL ANSWER LINE
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
if hot_cold:
    parts = [f"{b} ({typ}, LocalI={Iv:.4f}, p={pv:.4f})" for b,(typ,Iv,pv) in hot_cold.items()]
    final_line = "FINAL ANSWER: " + ", ".join(parts)
else:
    final_line = "FINAL ANSWER: none"

print(final_line)
